# ONLYOFFICE DocSpace: UI Kit

> The React component library every ONLYOFFICE Apps product and DocSpace plugin is built with.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. For the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [UI Kit](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit.md): @onlyoffice/apps-ui-kit is the React component library every ONLYOFFICE Apps product is built with, and the UI a DocSpace plugin renders its screens in. Start with Getting started for the two providers and the import forms, then pick a component by what it does.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started.md): What the kit is, how to install it, and the pieces every application sets up once: the theme and translation providers, the API client, and the hooks, utilities and constants the components share.
- [ONLYOFFICE Apps UI Kit](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/welcome.md): Version 4.0.0 • AGPL-3.0-only • not on the public npm registry yet -- How to install it
- [Structure](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/structure.md): @onlyoffice/apps-ui-kit is a standalone repository. It builds, tests and runs this
- [Themes](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/themes.md): The UI Kit ships with Base (light) and Dark themes. Styling is SCSS Modules plus CSS
- [Translation](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/translation.md): The UI Kit uses i18next and react-i18next for internationalization. Translation resources are passed in at the application level via TranslationProvider.
- [Agent skills](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/agent-skills.md): The ui-kit skill teaches an AI coding agent to build screens with this kit in your own React
- [API](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/api.md): Portal-internal. Everything on this page needs a DocSpace portal: a URL, an API key and a
- [Types and roles](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/types-and-roles.md): What a person may do in ONLYOFFICE Apps depends on two separate things. Most access bugs
- [Hooks](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/hooks.md): Eleven hooks, barrelled in hooks/index.ts and re-exported from the package root. They are
- [Utils](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/utils.md): utils/ holds the non-visual half of the library: 32 modules of date maths, device
- [Constants, enums and types](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/getting-started/constants.md): Three small modules carry the values and the vocabulary the rest of the library is written

## Components

- [Components](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components.md): The composites built from the UI components for the portal's screens. Of these, the providers are public; the rest need DocSpace context.
- [ai-chat](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/ai-chat.md): {/*
- [AI Settings](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/ai-settings.md): The portal's AI settings screens, from `ai-agent/settings`. Each is a page of `@onlyoffice/ai-chat` with the kit's layout applied, and reads and writes the same AI service the chat talks to, so it has to sit inside `AiAgentProviders`. Without a portal the stories run against the demo portal the mock service worker plays, under a banner that says so: its models, assignments and MCP servers are made up, and a change is saved in memory only, until the page is reloaded. ```tsx import AiAgentProviders from "@onlyoffice/apps-ui-kit/ai-agent/providers"; import { AiModels } from "@onlyoffice/apps-ui-kit/ai-agent/settings"; <AiAgentProviders locale="en" isAvailable> <AiModels /> </AiAgentProviders>; ```
- [Files](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/files.md): The Files section as the portal draws it: a header, the filter bar and the rows of the caller's
- [Rooms](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/rooms.md): The Rooms section: the active rooms the caller can see, with a header, the filter bar and the
- [Forms](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/forms.md): The Forms section: the form-filling rooms the caller can see, with a header, the filter bar and
- [billing](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/billing.md): {/*
- [Uploader](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/uploader.md): Uploader is a file upload component that supports chunked uploads, folder uploads, and file size validation. It uses the ONLYOFFICE Apps API SDK for upload operations and provides a drag-and-drop interface.
- [Document Editor](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/document-editor.md): DocumentEditor wraps the \@onlyoffice/document-editor-react\ component, embedding an ONLYOFFICE Document Server editor into the UI.
- [Selectors](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/selectors.md): The portal's pickers: a panel that lists files, rooms, people, groups, AI agents or MCP servers from a portal and hands back what the user chose.
- [aiagentselector](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/selectors/aiagentselector.md): {/*
- [filesselector](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/selectors/filesselector.md): {/*
- [groupsselector](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/selectors/groupsselector.md): {/*
- [mcpserversselector](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/selectors/mcpserversselector.md): {/*
- [peopleselector](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/selectors/peopleselector.md): {/*
- [roomselector](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/selectors/roomselector.md): {/*
- [Providers](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/providers.md): The providers an application mounts above the components. ThemeProvider and TranslationProvider are required -- without them components render unstyled and without text -- and ErrorBoundary catches a render failure below it.
- [apiprovider](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/providers/apiprovider.md): {/*
- [ErrorBoundary](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/providers/error-boundary.md): Catches what the subtree throws while rendering and shows something in its place.
- [ThemeProvider](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/providers/theme.md): Resolves the light, dark or system theme and writes it onto the document for every component to read.
- [TranslationProvider](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/providers/translation.md): Installs the i18next instance the eleven components with labels of their own read from.
- [Errors](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/errors.md): The full-page states the portal shows when a request fails: access denied, not found, offline, unavailable, an expired link.
- [accessrestricted](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/errors/accessrestricted.md): {/*
- [error401](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/errors/error401.md): {/*
- [error403](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/errors/error403.md): {/*
- [error404](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/errors/error404.md): {/*
- [errorinvalidlink](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/errors/errorinvalidlink.md): {/*
- [erroroffline](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/errors/erroroffline.md): {/*
- [errorunavailable](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/components/errors/errorunavailable.md): {/*

## UI

- [UI](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui.md): The components themselves, grouped by what they do on a page: controls, overlays, data display, navigation, feedback and layout.
- [Form controls](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls.md): Inputs, pickers and the containers that label them. Every control here is controlled: it renders the value it is given and reports changes through its callback.
- [AccessRightSelect](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/access-right-select.md): Drop-down for choosing an access level, with an icon, a description and a paid badge on each row.
- [Calendar](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/calendar.md): Month grid for picking a day, with month and year views behind it.
- [Checkbox](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/checkbox.md): Checkbox with a label, an indeterminate state and an optional help button.
- [ColorInput](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/color-input.md): Hex field with a swatch that opens a colour picker.
- [ColorPicker](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/color-picker.md): Saturation square with a hue strip for choosing a colour, with or without a hex field and buttons.
- [ComboBox](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/combobox.md): Button showing the current choice, with a list of options under it.
- [DatePicker](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/date-picker.md): Button that becomes a removable chip once a date is chosen, with a calendar behind it.
- [DateTimePicker](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/date-time-picker.md): A date chip and a time beside it, editable in place.
- [EmailInput](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/email-input.md): Text field that parses what is typed as an email address and colours itself when it does not parse.
- [FieldContainer](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/field-container.md): Layout wrapper for one form field: an optional label with a help tooltip, the control itself, and its error message.
- [FileInput](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/file-input.md): Read-only field with a folder icon that opens the file dialog and accepts a drop.
- [FormWrapper](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/form-wrapper.md): White card of a fixed width that the portal's sign-in and wizard forms sit on.
- [InputBlock](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/input-block.md): Text field with an icon at the end and room for a prefix before it, inside one border.
- [Label](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/label.md): Caption for a form field, with an optional required asterisk and an error colour.
- [PasswordInput](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/password-input.md): Password field with a reveal eye, a strength tooltip and a generator.
- [QuantityPicker](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/quantity-picker.md): Minus and plus around a number, with an optional slider and quick-add chips.
- [RadioButtonGroup](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/radio-button-group.md): A set of radio buttons built from an array, with the selected value handled for you.
- [RadioButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/radio-button.md): One option of a single-choice set, drawn as a labelled circle.
- [SearchInput](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/search-input.md): Search field with a magnifier, an optional clear button and a debounced change callback.
- [Slider](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/slider.md): Range input with the kit's own track and handle.
- [TextInput](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/text-input.md): Controlled single-line text field in three fixed widths, with optional masking, error and warning states.
- [Textarea](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/textarea.md): Multi-line text field that grows with its content, with optional line numbers, a copy button and a JSON mode.
- [TimePicker](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/time-picker.md): Two small fields, hours and minutes, that move the caret along as you type.
- [ToggleButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/form-controls/toggle-button.md): Switch for one on/off setting, with an optional label beside it.
- [Interactive elements](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements.md): Buttons in their variants -- plain, icon, floating, main-menu -- and the drag-and-drop surfaces: components whose job is to be clicked or dragged.
- [ActionButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/action-button.md): Small tinted button for a secondary action, optionally rendered as another element.
- [AddButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/add-button.md): Square icon button with an optional label beside it, for adding one more of something.
- [Button](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/button.md): Labelled action button with an optional icon, a loading state and a tooltip, in a primary or secondary variant.
- [ContextMenuButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/context-menu-button.md): Icon that opens a menu of actions, built afresh from a callback each time it is clicked.
- [DragAndDrop](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/drag-and-drop.md): Wrapper that turns whatever is inside it into a drop target for files, with no interface of its own.
- [Dropzone](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/dropzone.md): Dashed upload area with a picture, a prompt and a format list, which turns into a loader while the upload runs.
- [FloatingButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/floating-button.md): Round corner badge that shows the progress of a background operation and opens its panel.
- [HelpButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/help-button.md): Info icon that opens an explanation on click, for a label that needs more than a label.
- [IconButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/icon-button.md): Icon that acts as a button, with hover and pressed colours and an optional tooltip.
- [ImageEditor](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/image-editor.md): Crop window with drag, zoom and a replace control, for turning an uploaded picture into an avatar or a logo.
- [LinkWithDropdown](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/link-with-dropdown.md): Dashed link that opens a menu under itself.
- [MainButtonMobile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/main-button-mobile.md): Floating round button in the corner of the screen that opens a full-width sheet of actions.
- [MainButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/interactive-elements/main-button.md): Accent button at the top of a side menu that opens a menu of the things a user can create.
- [Status components](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/status-components.md): Loaders and progress: spinners, the full-screen application loader, the infinite-scroll loader and the progress bar.
- [AppLoader](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/status-components/app-loader.md): The blank first screen: a fixed sheet over the whole viewport with the kit's rombs animation on it.
- [InfiniteLoader](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/status-components/infinite-loader.md): Virtualised list or grid that asks for the next page as the user scrolls towards the end.
- [LoaderWrapper](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/status-components/loader-wrapper.md): Dims whatever is inside it and stops the mouse reaching it while something is loading.
- [Loader](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/status-components/loader.md): Spinner in one of four animations, for work whose duration is unknown.
- [ProgressBar](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/status-components/progress-bar.md): A labelled bar for an operation whose progress you can measure, with a status or error line under it.
- [Layout](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout.md): The page's plumbing: portals, scroll areas, the selection rectangle and the theme wrapper.
- [Article](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout/article.md): DocSpace's left panel: a fixed column with a header slot, a main button, a scrolling body and the profile block.
- [Portal](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout/portal.md): Renders a node into another part of the document, after mount, keeping it inside the React tree.
- [Scrollbar](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout/scrollbar.md): Scrolling region with the kit's own thin tracks, which fade out when nothing is happening.
- [Section](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout/section.md): DocSpace's page body: a sticky header and filter, a scrolling body, and the info and chat panels beside it.
- [SelectionArea](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout/selection-area.md): Rubber-band selection: a dragged rectangle that reports which items it covers, frame by frame.
- [ThemeProviderComponent](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout/theme-provider.md): The older theme provider: it writes the theme onto the document and supplies the kit's theme context.
- [Layout components](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout-components.md): Screens for the moments a view has nothing to show: an empty folder, a search with no results, an error.
- [ArticleItem](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout-components/articleitem.md): One catalog entry of the Article panel's body: an icon, a label and an optional badge. The Article page describes it in full.
- [EmptyScreenContainer](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout-components/empty-screen-container.md): Centred empty state: an illustration, a heading, up to two lines of explanation and a column of actions.
- [EmptyView](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout-components/empty-view.md): Centred empty state with an icon, a title, a description and a list of things the user can do next.
- [ErrorContainer](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/layout-components/error-container.md): Full-screen error page: an animated landscape, a heading, an explanation and one action button.
- [Overlays](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays.md): Everything drawn above the page: modal dialogs and side panels, drop-downs and context menus, tooltips and the selector.
- [Aside](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/aside.md): Panel that slides in from the side of the viewport, with a header and a scrolling body.
- [AsideHeader](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/aside-header.md): Title bar of a side panel or a dialog, with a back arrow, extra icons and the close cross.
- [AvatarEditorDialog](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/avatar-editor-dialog.md): Modal that frames an uploaded picture: the kit's crop window between a title and a save and cancel pair.
- [Backdrop](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/backdrop.md): Full-screen layer behind an overlay, transparent by default, that catches the click meant to close it.
- [ContextMenu](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/context-menu.md): Menu opened at the pointer through a ref, with submenus, a mobile sheet form and working keyboard navigation.
- [DropDownItem](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/drop-down-item.md): One row of a dropdown menu: a label, an optional icon and badges, or a separator.
- [DropDown](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/drop-down.md): Menu anchored to a control, rendered in a portal and positioned against the element you point it at.
- [ModalDialog](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/modal-dialog.md): Dialog rendered in a portal, as a centred modal or a side panel, assembled from Header, Body, Footer and Container slots.
- [RoomLogoCoverDialog](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/room-logo-cover-dialog.md): Dialog for a room's generated logo: a colour from the palette and an optional glyph, over a live preview.
- [Selector](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/selector.md): Panel for picking one or many things out of a list too long to render at once.
- [Tooltip](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/overlays/tooltip.md): Floating hint attached to one or more anchors, rendered in a portal and positioned to stay in the viewport.
- [Data display](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display.md): Components that show a value rather than take one: text and headings, avatars, badges and tags, room icons and logos, and cards.
- [Avatar](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/avatar.md): Round picture of a person or a group, falling back to initials, with an optional role badge and an edit menu.
- [Badge](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/badge.md): Small coloured pill for a count or a short marker, announced as a live status region.
- [Card](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/card.md): Grey panel with an optional header row, for a block of related information.
- [CategoryItem](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/category-item.md): Settings-page entry: a linked title, a line of explanation, an arrow, and an optional paid badge.
- [CollapsibleCard](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/collapsible-card.md): Panel whose header is a button that expands and collapses the body under it.
- [Heading](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/heading.md): Section title rendered as a real heading element, sized by a preset rather than by its level.
- [MCPIcon](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/mcp-icon.md): Square icon for an MCP server: its logo, or the first letter of its name on a grey tile.
- [PortalLogo](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/portal-logo.md): The portal's white-label logo, fetched from the DocSpace server and swapped for the theme.
- [QuickActions](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/quick-actions.md): Horizontal strip of large icon tiles that scrolls when the tiles no longer fit.
- [RoomIcon](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/room-icon.md): Square room tile that shows the room's logo, or its initials on a colour when there is none.
- [RoomLogo](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/room-logo.md): Fixed 32px glyph saying which kind of room this is, with an optional selection checkbox.
- [RoomType](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/room-type.md): Row offering one kind of room, with its glyph, its translated name and its description.
- [SelectedItem](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/selected-item.md): Chip with a cross, for a value the user has picked and can take back.
- [Tag](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/tag.md): Small outlined label for one keyword, clickable and optionally removable.
- [Tags](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/tags.md): One row of tags that keeps to its width, collapsing the rest into an overflow tag.
- [Text](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/data-display/text.md): Body text at the kit's size and weight, rendered through whichever element you name.
- [Skeletons](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/skeletons.md): Placeholder shapes shown while content loads, so the layout does not jump when it arrives.
- [CircleSkeleton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/skeletons/circle.md): Round loading placeholder with a sweeping highlight, for an avatar or an icon that has not arrived yet.
- [RectangleSkeleton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/skeletons/rectangle.md): Rectangular loading placeholder with a sweeping highlight, sized to the content it stands in for.
- [Feedback](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback.md): Components that tell the user what happened or what is happening: toasts and snack bars, status messages, info bars and progress for long operations.
- [ColumnarInfoBar](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback/columnar-info-bar.md): Bar of label-and-value columns for context the reader does not have to act on.
- [LoadingButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback/loading-button.md): 16px progress ring with a cross in the middle, for cancelling what it is measuring.
- [OperationsProgressButton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback/operations-progress-button.md): Corner badge that reports every background operation of the portal and lists them when there is more than one.
- [PublicRoomBar](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback/public-room-bar.md): Grey note above a screen's content: an icon, a bold line and a paragraph, with an optional close cross.
- [SnackBar](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback/snackbar.md): Full-width notification bar that sits at the top of a section until it is dismissed.
- [StatusMessage](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback/status-message.md): A full-width bar with a danger glyph that fades one message out before fading the next one in.
- [Toast](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback/toast.md): Container the transient notifications are stacked in, driven by the imperative `toastr`.
- [TopLoaderService](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/feedback/top-loading-indicator.md): The thin bar at the top of the page, driven by three static calls rather than by React.
- [Navigation](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation.md): Links, tabs, paging and the side menu that moves the user between views.
- [FilterInput](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation/filter.md): The bar above a file listing: search, a filter panel, a sort menu, a view switch and the chips for what is in force.
- [Link](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation/link.md): Anchor styled to the kit's conventions, for navigation or for an in-place action.
- [NavMenu](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation/nav-menu.md): Sidebar navigation: groups of items, each with an optional sub-menu, a badge and a collapsed rail form.
- [Navigation](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation/navigation-component.md): The file manager's header: breadcrumb title, back arrow, and the row of buttons that acts on the current folder.
- [Paging](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation/paging.md): Previous and next buttons with a page selector between them and a page-size selector at the end.
- [TabItem](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation/tab-item.md): Rounded pill that fills in when it is selected.
- [Tabs](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation/tabs.md): Sticky tab bar that scrolls sideways and renders the selected tab's content under itself.
- [TwoStateToggle](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/navigation/two-state-toggle.md): Pill that switches the portal between its classic view and the new dashboard.
- [Rows](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/rows.md): The file list of the DocSpace portal, in three parts: the container, the row and the row's content.
- [RowContainer](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/rows/row-container.md): Scrolling list the rows go in, virtualised and paged in as the user reaches the end.
- [RowContent](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/rows/row-content.md): The text of a row, laid out by the position of its children rather than by named slots.
- [Row](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/rows/row.md): One row of the file list: an optional checkbox, a start element, the content and a context menu.
- [RowsSkeleton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/rows/rowsskeleton.md): Placeholder in the shape of a list of rows, shown while the rows themselves are loading. The Rows page describes it in full.
- [Table](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table.md): Columnar list with resizable, sortable and hideable columns, laid out by a CSS grid the header writes.
- [GroupMenuItem](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/groupmenuitem.md): GroupMenuItem is one action button of a TableGroupMenu, the toolbar that replaces the table header while rows are selected. The Table README describes it in full.
- [TableCell](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/tablecell.md): TableCell is one cell of a TableRow: a fixed-height box that sits in the column the table's grid gives it. The Table README describes it in full.
- [TableHeaderCell](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/tableheadercell.md): TableHeaderCell is the title of one column in a TableHeader, with its sort arrow and the handle that resizes it. The Table README describes it in full.
- [TableSettings](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/tablesettings.md): TableSettings is the cog at the end of a TableHeader that opens a list of the columns, each with a checkbox that shows or hides it. The Table README describes it in full.
- [TableBody](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/tablebody.md): TableBody holds the rows of a table and, for a long list, renders only the rows in view and asks for the next page as the user scrolls. The Table README describes it in full.
- [TableContainer](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/tablecontainer.md): TableContainer is the outer element of a table, the grid that the header, the group menu and the rows are laid out in. The Table README describes it in full.
- [TableGroupMenu](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/tablegroupmenu.md): TableGroupMenu is the toolbar that takes the place of the table header while rows are selected, with a select-all checkbox and the actions that apply to the selection. The Table README describes it in full.
- [TableHeader](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/tableheader.md): TableHeader is the row of column titles at the top of a table; it also decides the width of every column and writes them onto the table's grid. The Table README describes it in full.
- [TableRow](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/table/tablerow.md): TableRow is one row of a table: its cells followed by a last cell with the row's context menu button. The Table README describes it in full.
- [Tiles](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles.md): The card view of the DocSpace listing: a sorting container, four kinds of tile and the slot their names go in.
- [BaseTile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles/base-tile.md): The tile shell: an icon that turns into a checkbox, a slot for the content, a three-dot menu and a lower half.
- [FileTile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles/file-tile.md): Tile for a document: a thumbnail with badges over it, and a name row with a checkbox and a menu.
- [FolderTile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles/folder-tile.md): Tile for a folder, as a single name row or, with one flag, a tall card with a picture on top.
- [RoomTile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles/room-tile.md): Tile for a room: the logo and name on top, and the room's tags along the bottom.
- [TilesSkeleton](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles/tilesskeleton.md): Placeholder in the shape of a tile listing, shown while the tiles themselves are loading. The Tiles page describes it in full.
- [TemplateTile](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles/template-tile.md): Tile for a room template: the name on top, and an owner and storage pair along the bottom.
- [TileContainer](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles/tile-container.md): Grid that sorts the tiles it is given into rooms, templates, folders and files and gives two of them a heading.
- [TileContent](https://ilyaoleshko.github.io/api.onlyoffice.com/docspace/ui-kit/ui/tiles/tile-content.md): The title slot of a tile: three nested wrappers that give the name its width and its truncation.
